concept: Cast Iron Coffee leans into the warm, modern-rustic soul of a third-wave DeKalb roaster: a deep, rich espresso-brown carries the brand, lifted by a glowing burnt-amber caramel accent that reads like crema and copper roasting drums. Backgrounds pour out in soft oat-milk cream so pages feel cozy and unhurried, while a roasted near-black ink keeps type crisp and editorial. The result is artisan and inviting, with cast-iron weight in the darks and a toasty, hand-pulled warmth across the surface tones.
contrastNotes: All required ratios verified against the WCAG relative-luminance formula. ink #231A13 on bg #F6F0E3 = 15.05:1 (>=7); ink-soft #5C4A3B on bg = 7.40:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #4A2C1E = 12.57:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg = 11.07:1 (>=3). Also holds: ink on white surface 17.09:1, ink-soft on surface-alt 6.72:1, white on primary-dark 16.51:1, white on secondary #7A4B30 7.30:1. Accent #B5651D on bg = 3.82:1 (large-text/UI-graphic only); pair accent with ink or white text on solid fills rather than as small text on cream.
